title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Garden Auditorium on 1966-07-29

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording of an early‑1966 set highlighted by a smoking Cream Puff War and solid early Garcia guitar work, though two non‑show filler tracks are included.
ai_review.review: The performance captures the raw, hot energy of the Dead in July 1966, with reviewers praising a standout rendition of "Cream Puff War" and Pigpen’s organ. The soundboard mix is described as great and crystal‑clear, making it an enjoyable listen despite the odd inclusion of two post‑show filler tracks from David Gans.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently give 4–5 stars for both performance and recording quality, highlighting strong early playing and excellent soundboard mix; the only drawback is extraneous filler tracks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with great balance; Pigpen's organ sounds great. Two final tracks are unrelated David Gans recordings left in by the uploader.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show starts hot and builds hotter, delivering classic 1966 Dead energy; ending is marred by two filler tracks that do not belong to the original set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Early Garcia brilliance highlighted; guitar work praised as excellent on "Cream Puff War".
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ sounding great throughout the performance.
